create_triangular_linear_bijector: create a TriangularLinear bijector with a square matrix and is_lower flag for f(x)=Ax transformations
forward_triangular_linear: compute the forward transformation y=Ax using a TriangularLinear bijector on input array x
inverse_triangular_linear: compute the inverse transformation x=f^-1(y) by solving the triangular system Ax=y
forward_log_det_jacobian_triangular: compute the log absolute determinant of the Jacobian for a TriangularLinear bijector in O(D)
same_as_triangular_linear: compare two TriangularLinear bijectors to check if they share the same matrix and is_lower settings
